items.title: 70980_Quinn Wilson oral history interview
items.q: he made some records in my place with Jelly Roll -- Beauford... This must have been around the same time I recorded with Jelly Roll

ctx.x: And then -- then everybody'd come back in, then there would be another section with maybe just drums and piano, and clarinet. To change the texture of the rhythm section. Was that a common thing back in the twenties?
I don't know, I never experienced that. Exception with Jelly. You know, on recording.
Yeah. Louie used to do that on some of his records, where the full band would play, and then come down to just Louie and --

items.title: 70980_Quinn Wilson oral history interview
items.q: Just about the same as Jelly's. Same instrumentation.

ctx.x: Well, what kind of bands did he have?
Just about the same as Jelly's. Same instrumentation. Clarinet, trumpet, trombone, tuba.
Was he from New Orleans or Chicago?
